arStrings.szText: After reaching Level 60, new challenges and items await in {c_highlight}The Pit of the Artificer{/c} and {c_highlight}Torment{/c} difficulties.
The {c_highlight}Pit of the Artificer{/c} becomes available at Level 60 and can be accessed through the {c_highlight}Artificer's Obelisk{/c} in Cerrigar.
